technical.summary: BAC shows early momentum recovery signals (supertrend, MACD, PPO bullish) but lacks confluence; price remains below all key moving averages, oscillators are oversold without confirmation, and momentum indicators are mixed, making this a low-probability entry despite technical bounce setup.

fundamental.summary: BAC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 4 days present elevated volatility risk with no supporting smart money accumulation.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with critical earnings binary event in 4 days create extremely elevated risk for BAC.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend, MACD, and PPO bullish signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (33/100) and price near support (27.64) offer contrarian bounce setup with limited downside risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 4 days, crisis-level VIX, price below all major moving averages, oversold oscillators without confirmation, zero fundamental conviction, and severe macro headwinds create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While supertrend/MACD bullish signals and extreme fear sentiment (33/100) offer contrarian appeal at support, the critical earnings binary in 4 days combined with crisis VIX and price below all major moving averages creates unacceptable risk-reward for new swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 4 days will likely trigger violent price movement regardless of technical setup; macro headwinds (crisis VIX, rising dollar, flat yield curve) amplify downside risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite technical bounce signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding BAC with 36 existing Financials positions (15.8% sector concentration); adding to existing position during earnings window and sector saturation violates risk discipline.
